_comment: Exit code of each gate script on the UNMUTATED baseline tree in this worktree, measured by tools/audit/round6/D3/prescreen.py --clean (which moves HEAD off the baseline with an empty commit so the ref-vs-HEAD guards inside env_drift.py and card_drift.mjs behave exactly as they do for a mutant) and by direct runs. A script that is non-zero here is EXCLUDED from kill attribution: it would otherwise report every mutant as killed. See REPORT.md, 'The control'.
